description: Composing two total computable many-one reductions gives a reduction from the first set to the third.
signature:
ManyOneReducible.trans.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β]
  [Primcodable γ] {p : α → Prop} {q : β → Prop} {r : γ → Prop} : p ≤₀ q → q ≤₀ r → p ≤₀ r
